detailed_descriptions_html.en:
VConnect - Connect Everything

VConnect is a streaming overlay and automation studio where you connect any live event to any on-screen reaction using a visual node editor. No coding knowledge necessary! Just drag, connect, and sit back to watch as your stream reacts.

FEATURES

  • Spawn assets: 3D-Models, images and GIFs with physics. Throw them, shoot fluids, have them collide, let them rain down on you etc! You can also place them as stickers on your screen!

  • React with your VTuber Model: expressions, movement, color changing, parameter animations and more

  • Audio: text-to-speech, sound effects and lip-sync.

  • And more! (Always working on adding new Nodes for different features and services!)

SERVICES

VConnect interacts with services you may already be using! Currently supported services include:

  • Twitch: chat, bits, follows, subs, gift subs, raids, channel point redeems, bans, commands. Create clips, post shoutouts, and send chat messages automatically.

  • YouTube: chat, Super Chats, Super Stickers, new members, milestones, membership gifting, commands.

  • VTube Studio: drive parameters, trigger expressions and hotkeys, move or punch your model, tint artmeshes, swap models, load custom items, adjust physics live.

  • OBS: switch scenes and react to scene changes.

  • Streamlabs & StreamElements: donations, tips, merch, charity, loyalty store and reward redeems.

  • Pulsoid: turn your heart rate into on-screen interactions!

HOW IT WORKS

VConnect has a Node Editor that does most of the heavy lifting!

BUT don't worry - you don't need to be a genius or power user to understand the program. There is a Setup-Wizard to make your ideas come to life!

For those more familiar with node systems, the possibilities are almost endless:

  • Triggers for every supported event, plus hotkeys and timers.

  • Logic and flow: conditions, loops, gates, toggles, math, randomness, lists, variables and string tools.

Everything runs in REAL TIME as your stream happens!

ASSETS

You can import PNG, GIFs, GLBs, GLTFs, FBX, VRM, OBJ & more.
You can also import sound effects in MP3 & OGG!

For Twitch Users: If your Twitch account is connected, it can directly import all your channel emotes to VConnect, as well as Global Twitch emotes and BTTV / 7TV / FrankerFaceZ Emotes featured on your channel!

VConnect has an extensive editor. You can adjust your imported asset in size, material, color, etc. to make sure you have the best customization possible.

ACCESSIBILITY

This program is aimed at VTubers, but regular streamers can also use this tool for various things! Here is some options:

  • Auto-shoutout raiders who bring in a certain number of viewers.

  • Auto-clip the exact moment something cool happens on your stream!

  • Milestones: celebrate the Nth follower, sub or donation with a custom effect ~

  • Cross-service combos - for example: incoming super chat can interact with your OBS scene and create a fun interaction / event as it reads itself out loud with TTS!

  • Heartrate monitor makes your screen react!

SHARE - IMPORT & EXPORT

You can share your creations with friends and other creators! With VConnect, it's possible to export your assets and entire node setups, so that the person on the receiving end can import it to their own VConnect service with no friction. To stop it from getting too confusing, there is Profiles and Folders to organise the program as your collection grows ^-^

Why VConnect?

  • VConnect is one tool for all your services! No more juggling a bunch of bots.

  • No need for coding knowledge: drag -> connect -> test instantly!

  • Share : Export your creations to your community or other streamers.

THIS IS A LONG TERM, GROWING PROGRAM. Active customer support and continuous development to implement user feedback and new exciting nodes ^-^
